# ArenaPro — All-in-One Tournament, Club & Matchday OS

> ArenaPro (`https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/`) is a free multi-organizer web platform for organizing football, turf, futsal, cricket, campus, and community sports competitions from A to Z. It unifies self-registration with waitlists, live multi-device auction & spin-the-wheel drafts, automated round-robin & knockout brackets, configurable tiebreakers, persistent clubs, and cross-season verified player career passports.

## Core Platform URLs
- [Homepage & Platform Overview](https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/): Live stats, matchday stories, featured tournaments, capabilities, and FAQs.
- [Tournaments Directory](https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/tournaments/): Browse public leagues/knockouts, create a tournament, or enter a 6-character Join Code.
- [Clubs & Franchises Directory](https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/clubs/): Create persistent clubs, publish home grounds & trophy cabinets, and manage recruitment requests.
- [Players & Career Passports](https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/players/): Search verified career stats across seasons and compare players with 5-axis SVG attribute radars.
- [Stories & Sports Blog](https://mini-tournament-45ac1.web.app/blog/): Matchday visual stories, A–Z tutorials, draft strategy comparisons, tiebreaker rules, and organizer playbooks.

## Verified Product Facts (Quick Reference)
- Cost: Free for organizers, captains, and players (`$0`, web-based, no app store install required).
- Supported Competition Formats: Round-Robin League, Single-Elimination Knockout (with penalty shootouts), and Hybrid (League + Top-N Playoffs).
- Player Drafting Modes: Live multi-device synced Auction Draft (with budget guardrails & minimum reserve checks) and animated Spin-the-Wheel Draft.
- Onboarding & Legacy Migration: 6-character Join Codes, direct invite links, capacity caps + automatic waitlists, Google Sign-In linking to preserve legacy stats.
- Analytics: Dynamic League Standings, Configurable Tiebreakers (GD / H2H / GF / Wins), Head-to-Head Matrix grid, 5-axis SVG Player Radar Charts, Matchday RSVP, Starting Lineup Builder, and Fan Prediction Polls.
